messages:
nina: Observing repeated tiny-GPU eviction ripples in us-west2-b since ~11:40 PST. Looks like pod handoffs are causing tight packing oscillation.

omar: saw 30 small preempts in the last 20m. Heatmap shows one rack at 92% GPU util and adjacent racks at 20%. Scheduler keeps trying strict rackAffinity and then falling back.

daryl: logs indicate taint-based eviction churn: nodes temporarily tainted `maintenance=scheduled:NoSchedule` for short maintenance scripts, pods get preempted then rescheduled across racks. That plus strict affinity explains fragmentation.

omar: short-term: remove the transient taint application window and instead cordon+drain in larger chunks. Also bump deschedule grace from 10s -> 60s to avoid immediate preempts.

nina: agree. Can we also relax rackAffinity weight for <=1gpu jobs (100 -> 70) as a canary in us-west2-b? Limits cross-rack movement.

daryl: will run a 30m canary for weight change and schedule a maintenance rollout that uses `drainStrategy: batch` instead of tainting.

ops-bot: ticket INF-2005 created: transient-taint-evict-frag. assigned @daryl @omar. Canary scheduled now.

omar: monitoring p95 scheduling and eviction rate. If eviction rate <0.5% after 30m we keep change; else rollback.

nina: rolling metrics look better at 10m mark: evictions dropped ~60% and rack imbalance slowly evening. Will post follow-up RCA for taint use pattern.
